begin<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>definition set_ab :: "ident \<Rightarrow> bool \<Rightarrow> ('a, 'b) p_state \<Rightarrow> ('a, 'b) p_state" where
  "set_ab ident trying s = (s \<lparr> ab_v := (ab_v s) (ident := trying) \<rparr>)"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>definition set_label :: "ident \<Rightarrow> label \<Rightarrow> ('a, 'b) p_state \<Rightarrow> ('a, 'b) p_state" where
  "set_label ident label s = (s \<lparr> ab_label := (ab_label s) (ident := label) \<rparr>)"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>definition locked :: "ident \<Rightarrow> ('a, 'b) p_state \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "locked ident s = (ab_v s (other_ident ident) \<longrightarrow> t_v s = ident)"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>definition acquire_lock :: "ident \<Rightarrow> (('a, 'b) p_state, unit) tmonad" where
  "acquire_lock ident = do
     interference;
     modify (set_ab ident True);
     modify (\<lambda>s. s \<lparr> t_v := other_ident ident \<rparr>);
     modify (set_label ident Awaiting);
     interference;
     Await (locked ident);
     modify (set_label ident Critical)
   od"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>definition release_lock :: "ident \<Rightarrow> (('a, 'b) p_state, unit) tmonad" where
  "release_lock ident = do
     modify (set_ab ident False);
     modify (set_label ident Exited);
     interference;
     return ()
   od"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>definition abs_critical_section :: "(('a, 'b) p_state, unit) tmonad" where

     interference

  "peterson_rel ident s_prior s =
     (\<comment> \<open>assume invs\<close> invs s_prior \<longrightarrow>
            \<comment> \<open>invariants are preserved\<close>
        (invs s
            \<comment> \<open>I won't adjust your variables\<close>
         \<and> (ab_v s (other_ident ident) = ab_v s_prior (other_ident ident))
         \<and> (ab_label s (other_ident ident) = ab_label s_prior (other_ident ident))
            \<comment> \<open>I will only ever give you priority\<close>
         \<and> (t_v s_prior = other_ident ident \<longrightarrow> t_v s = other_ident ident)
            \<comment> \<open>If you're in the critical section, I won't change cs2_v and cs1_v\<close>
         \<and> (critical (ab_label s_prior (other_ident ident))
              \<longrightarrow> cs2_v s = cs2_v s_prior \<and> cs1_v s = cs1_v s_prior)))"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>lemma peterson_rel_rtranclp[simp]:
